airport: An airport features expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings, large terminal buildings, and extensive aprons with parked aircraft, distinguishing it from the parallel linear railway tracks of railway stations, the dense factory structures of industrial areas, the dense building clusters of commercial areas, the large oval structures of stadiums, and the flat gray grid of parking lots.
airplane: An airplane appears as a compact, bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings and fuselage on a uniform gray runway or tarmac surface, distinguishing it from the elongated linear pavement of runways, the rectangular building rooftops, the circular farmland patterns, and the small vehicle rectangles in parking lots.
baseball_diamond: A baseball diamond displays a diamond-shaped infield with four bases and surrounding green outfield, distinguishing it from the oval red track surrounding a ground track field, the small rectangular surface of a basketball court, and the rectangular green pitch of a tennis court.
basketball_court: A basketball court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with distinctive orange or brown coloring, crisp white boundary lines, and a visible center circle and key areas, distinguishing it from the larger rectangular football fields, the small square tennis courts, the uniform green meadow grass, and the gray paved parking lots.
beach: A beach appears as a broad, smooth expanse of fine light tan or white sand with a gentle natural transition to water and subtle wave patterns along the shoreline, distinguishing it from the sinuous dark water ribbon of rivers, the rugged rocky terrain of mountains, the enclosed still water of lakes, the vast uniform dry sand of deserts, and the dock infrastructure of harbors.
bridge: A bridge appears as a linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body such as a river, with visible support pillars and shadow patterns on the water surface below, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated roadway of overpasses, the parallel railway lines of railways, the linear runway pavement, and the dock structures of harbors.
chaparral: Chaparral exhibits a dense, rough, and uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation with irregular brownish-green tones and no organized geometric pattern, distinguishing it from the smooth uniform green of meadows, the regular crop row patterns of rectangular farmland, the circular patterns of circular farmland, the stepped patterns of terraces, and the smooth flat surfaces of parking lots.
church: A church features a distinctive rectangular building with a prominent tall steeple or spire, often with a cross-shaped floor plan visible from above, surrounded by small parking areas and open space, distinguishing it from the dense building clusters of commercial areas, the large flat-roofed industrial buildings, the rectangular school buildings, and the tightly packed residential rooftops.
circular_farmland: Circular farmland displays large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation systems with radiating linear textures and alternating green and brown tones, distinguishing it from the rectangular gridded crop patterns of rectangular farmland, the stepped linear patterns of terraces, the vast uniform dry sand of deserts, the rough shrubby vegetation of chaparral, and the smooth white sea ice textures.
cloud: A cloud appears as a large, soft-edged, bright white mass with smooth billowy or wispy texture casting diffuse shadows on the ground below, distinguishing it from the bright white smooth surface of snowberg, the light tan uniform tones of desert, the gray paved surfaces of airports, and the bright white linear runway markings.
commercial_area: Commercial areas display dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings with flat rooftops, extensive paved parking lots between structures, and regular street grids, distinguishing them from the large factory buildings of industrial areas, the tightly packed small rooftops of dense residential areas, the expansive runway surfaces of airports, and the open green spaces of parks.
dense_residential: Dense residential areas show tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing, narrow streets, and very limited green space between buildings, distinguishing them from the more spaced houses of medium residential areas, the uniform small structures of mobile home parks, the large flat-roofed buildings of commercial areas, and the continuous dark green canopy of forests.
desert: A desert presents a vast, uniform expanse of light tan or pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures and no vegetation, distinguishing it from the regular geometric crop patterns of circular farmland, the smooth white surface of sea ice, the light tan sand of beaches, the rugged rocky terrain of mountains, and the bright white cloud formations.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure or regular pattern, distinguishing it from the uniform bright green of meadows, the regular crop rows of rectangular farmland, the rugged terrain of mountains, the sinuous dark water of rivers, and the scattered trees of sparse residential areas.
freeway: A freeway appears as a long, wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings and consistent linear geometry, distinguishing it from the narrower single-track railway lines, the elevated crossing structure of overpasses, the sinuous natural curves of rivers, and the straight linear runway surfaces.
golf_course: A golf course features large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered sand bunkers, winding cart paths, and irregularly shaped greens and small water hazards, distinguishing it from the rigid grid patterns of rectangular farmland, the circular patterns of circular farmland, the rough natural vegetation of chaparral, and the uniform green of meadows.
ground_track_field: A ground track field displays a distinctive oval-shaped reddish-brown or blue running track surrounding a central rectangular green grass field, with clear lane markings, distinguishing it from the rectangular basketball courts, the circular farmland patterns, the uniform green meadows, and the rectangular football fields without surrounding tracks.
harbor: A harbor contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, cranes, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the uniform gray grid of parking lots, the calm enclosed water of lakes, the sinuous flowing rivers, the sandy shoreline of beaches, and the large factory buildings of industrial areas.
industrial_area: Industrial areas display large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops, clusters of circular storage tanks, wide internal roads, and minimal vegetation, distinguishing them from the dense commercial building clusters, the expansive airport runways, the regular crop patterns of farmland, the parallel railway tracks of railway stations, and the large oval structures of stadiums.
intersection: An intersection displays a clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads with visible lane markings and traffic infrastructure at the junction, distinguishing it from the continuous linear pavement of freeways, the parallel railway tracks of railways, the elevated structure of overpasses, and the large flat surfaces of parking lots.
island: An island appears as a distinct landmass completely surrounded by dark smooth water with irregular natural shoreline and vegetation cover, distinguishing it from the peninsular land connected to mainland, the linear sandbars of beaches, the dock-attached structures of harbors, and the artificial rectangular shapes of industrial zones.
lake: A lake appears as a large, enclosed, relatively smooth dark or blue-green water body with a natural irregular shoreline surrounded by land, distinguishing it from the sinuous narrow flowing ribbon of rivers, the small enclosed ponds, the ocean water adjacent to beaches, the structured dock waters of harbors, and the bright green turf of golf courses.
meadow: A meadow presents a broad, uniform expanse of bright green grass with a smooth fine texture and no visible geometric patterns, markings, or structures, distinguishing it from the precisely rectangular marked courts of basketball courts, the regular crop row patterns of rectangular farmland, the circular patterns of circular farmland, the rough shrubby texture of chaparral, and the dense dark green canopy of forests.
medium_residential: Medium residential areas feature moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards, a regular street grid, and a balanced mix of rooftops and green space, distinguishing them from the tightly packed rooftops of dense residential areas, the widely scattered houses of sparse residential areas, the uniform small structures of mobile home parks, and the large flat-roofed commercial buildings.
mobile_home_park: A mobile home park consists of many small, uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows with minimal green space, distinguishing it from the circular metallic geometry of thermal power stations, the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed buildings of commercial areas, the parallel linear railway tracks of railway stations, and the rugged rocky terrain of mountains.
mountain: Mountain terrain displays rugged, irregular topography with varied tones of rock and sparse vegetation, showing natural contour patterns and shadow variations from elevation changes, distinguishing it from the continuous dark green canopy of forests, the vast uniform dry sand of deserts, the smooth light tan sand of beaches, and the flat uniform surfaces of farmland.
overpass: An overpass appears as an elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road or feature, casting distinct shadows on the surface below, distinguishing it from the ground-level broad pavement of freeways, the water-crossing linear structure of bridges, the parallel railway lines of railways, and the long narrow strips of runways.
palace: A palace features a large symmetrical building complex with ornate rooftop structures, courtyards, and formal gardens, distinguishing it from the rectangular layout of a church, the dense grid pattern of dense residential, and the large warehouse rooftops of an industrial area.
parking_lot: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the stepped terraced agricultural patterns, the expansive smooth runways of airports, the irregular natural wetland textures, and the enclosed still water of lakes.
railway: A railway appears as one or more parallel thin linear tracks with regular cross-beam patterns running through the landscape, distinguishing it from the wide multi-lane pavement of freeways, the elevated concrete structure of overpasses, the straight linear runway surfaces, and the sinuous natural curves of rivers.
railway_station: A railway station features multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms, adjacent station buildings, and surrounding structures, distinguishing it from the expansive smooth runways and aprons of airports, the large factory buildings of industrial areas, the long continuous elevated roadway of overpasses, and the dense building clusters of commercial areas.
rectangular_farmland: Rectangular farmland displays large, regularly gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns, alternating color bands of green and brown, and clear geometric rectangular field boundaries, distinguishing it from the circular patterns of circular farmland, the stepped linear patterns of terraces, the uniform green of meadows, the vast dry sand of deserts, and the flat gray surfaces of parking lots.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the large enclosed still water of lakes, the smooth light tan sand of beaches, the continuous dark green canopy of forests, the linear elevated structures of bridges, and the structured dock waters of harbors.
roundabout: A roundabout appears as a circular paved road intersection with a central island, surrounded by connecting roads forming a continuous loop, distinguishing it from the angular cross-shaped intersections, the large circular farmland irrigation patterns, the oval ground track fields, and the small circular storage tanks in industrial areas.
runway: A runway is a very long, wide, straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement with centralized markings and surrounded by flat open tarmac, distinguishing it from the narrower multi-lane freeway with lane markings, the elevated structure of overpasses, the parallel thin tracks of railways, and the cross-shaped metallic object of airplanes.
sea_ice: Sea ice presents a vast, smooth, bright white to pale blue surface with subtle fracture lines and floating ice floe patterns, distinguishing it from the bright white cloud cover, the light tan desert sand, the smooth gray runway pavement, the white-capped ocean waves of beaches, and the bright white snowberg surfaces.
ship: A ship appears as a large, bright elongated rectangular or triangular object with a pointed bow on dark water, leaving a visible wake trail, distinguishing it from the small dark vehicle rectangles in parking lots, the metallic cross-shaped airplanes on runways, the linear dock structures of harbors, and the elongated bridge structures.
snowberg: A snowberg appears as a large, bright white, angular ice formation floating in dark ocean water with sharp geometric edges and visible calving faces, distinguishing it from the soft-edged bright white cloud formations, the vast smooth sea ice surfaces, the light tan beach sand, the white-capped wave patterns, and the gray industrial rooftops.
sparse_residential: Sparse residential areas show widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures, distinguishing them from the tightly packed rooftops of dense residential areas, the uniform rows of mobile home parks, the rough natural shrubs of chaparral, the continuous dark green forest canopy, and the regular crop patterns of farmland.
stadium: A stadium displays a large oval or rectangular enclosed structure with tiered seating visible as concentric rings, a central green field, and surrounding parking areas, distinguishing it from the large factory buildings of industrial areas, the expansive airport runways, the circular farmland irrigation patterns, the oval ground track fields, and the dense commercial building clusters.
storage_tank: A storage tank appears as a circular or cylindrical structure with a distinct round rooftop, often clustered in groups near industrial facilities, distinguishing it from the small white airplane on a runway, the circular layout of a roundabout, and the bright white snow cover of a snowberg.
tennis_court: A tennis court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with crisp white boundary lines, a central net line, and a uniform colored interior, often surrounded by fencing, distinguishing it from the larger basketball courts, the rectangular football fields, the uniform gray parking lot surfaces, the regular crop patterns of farmland, and the densely packed residential rooftops.
terrace: Terrace displays stepped, parallel linear agricultural patterns following natural terrain contours with alternating vegetation bands on sloped land, distinguishing it from the flat rectangular grid patterns of rectangular farmland, the circular patterns of circular farmland, the uniform green of meadows, the rough texture of chaparral, and the flat gray surfaces of parking lots.
thermal_power_station: A thermal power station features large industrial buildings with prominent tall cylindrical cooling towers emitting steam, clusters of smokestacks, and extensive surrounding industrial infrastructure, distinguishing it from the small narrow structures of mobile home parks, the rectangular factory buildings of industrial areas, the dense commercial buildings, and the large airport terminal structures.
wetland: A wetland displays an irregular mosaic of shallow water, mudflats, and dense marsh vegetation with a patchy mixed texture of dark water and green-brown plant clusters, distinguishing it from the uniform gray parking lot surfaces, the smooth enclosed water of lakes, the regular crop patterns of farmland, the uniform green meadows, and the dry uniform tones of desert.
